```{r}
#| label: evaluation-paradox
#| echo: false

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph evaluation_paradox {
  graph [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    bgcolor = 'transparent'
    nodesep = 0.8
    ranksep = 1.0
    label = 'Das Evaluationsparadox\\nUm KI-Output zu bewerten, braucht man Kompetenz, die erst durch Lernen entsteht'
    labelloc = t
    fontsize = 16
    fontcolor = '#666666'
  ]

  node [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 14
    style = 'filled,rounded'
    fontcolor = 'white'
    penwidth = 0
    shape = box
    margin = '0.25,0.15'
  ]

  edge [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 13
    color = '#999999'
    arrowsize = 0.8
  ]

  evaluate [
    label = 'KI-Output\\nbewerten'
    fillcolor = '#D55E00'
  ]

  competence [
    label = 'Fachkompetenz'
    fillcolor = '#64748b'
  ]

  learning [
    label = 'Eigenes\\nLernen'
    fillcolor = '#64748b'
  ]

  thinking [
    label = 'Eigenes\\nDenken'
    fillcolor = '#0072B2'
  ]

  center [
    label = 'Internes Modell\\nnoch nicht aufgebaut'
    fillcolor = '#F5F5F5'
    fontcolor = '#9A4665'
    style = 'filled'
    shape = plaintext
    fontsize = 13
  ]

  evaluate -> competence [label = '  erfordert  ']
  competence -> learning [label = '  entsteht durch  ']
  learning -> thinking [label = '  erfordert  ']
  thinking -> evaluate [label = '  wird ersetzt\\n  durch KI  ' style = dashed color = '#D55E00']
}
")
```
